definitions.explanation: A large wild cat known as the king of beasts. In Japanese, often used in cultural/traditional contexts.
The lion figure used in traditional Japanese performing arts like {獅子舞|ししまい}.

examples.japanese: {獅子|しし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{百獣|ひゃくじゅう}→百獣：25044_hyakujuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれて→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The lion is called "the king of beasts."

examples.japanese: ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{獅子舞|ししまい}→獅子舞：13515_shishimai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ました→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched a lion dance at New Year's.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入口|いりぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{獅子|しし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are lion statues at the shrine entrance.

examples.japanese: {獅子|しし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強|つよ}さ→強さ：25692_tsuyosa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{象徴|しょうちょう}→象徴：05534_shouchou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The lion is considered a symbol of strength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{獅子|しし}⟦{奮迅|ふんじん}→奮迅：28737_funjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: He showed a furious burst of activity.
examples.notes: {獅子|しし}{奮迅|ふんじん} is a four-character idiom meaning to fight with fierce energy

examples.japanese: ⟦{獅子舞|ししまい}→獅子舞：13515_shishimai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{噛|か}まれると→噛む：01205_kamu⟧⟦{縁起|えんぎ}→縁起：13815_engi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: It is said to be good luck to have your head bitten by a lion dancer.

notes:
{獅子|しし} is used in traditional/literary contexts. ⟦ライオン→ライオン：05197_raion⟧ (loanword) is more common in everyday speech for the actual animal.

Cultural significance:
- ⟦{獅子舞|ししまい}→獅子舞：13515_shishimai⟧ (lion dance) - performed at New Year's for good luck
- ⟦{狛犬|こまいぬ}→狛犬：07115_komainu⟧ (guardian lion-dogs) - stone statues at shrines

Common expressions:
- {獅子|しし}⟦{奮迅|ふんじん}→奮迅：28737_funjin⟧ (fighting with furious energy)
- {獅子|しし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子落|こお}とし→子落とし：28738_kootoshi⟧ (tough love - throwing a lion cub off a cliff)

The character {獅|し} specifically refers to lions, distinct from other large cats.
